name: Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana
benefit:
Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided:

  - 50% subsidy on the cost of fruit plants, open-field vegetable seeds, spice seeds, and flower seeds. No direct monetary assistance is provided; the seeds and plants are supplied at a subsidized rate.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
